rules.tables: The "Airlines and destinations" table of each airport's English Wikipedia article ({{Airport-dest-list}}) and the airlines-and-destinations table of its Vietnamese article, current revision (ids and timestamps in `articles`). Airlines and destinations are matched across the two languages by their Wikidata items (destination airports by IATA code, P238; airlines by IATA designator, P229). Links to a city instead of an airport, and destinations with no IATA code on Wikidata, are dropped (`dropped_links`).
rules.service: Each listing keeps the table's markers: "Seasonal:" / "Theo mùa:" → seasonal, "Charter:" / "Thuê chuyến:" → charter. A listing whose note says the service begins or resumes after the download date, or that it has stopped ("Đã ngừng", "tạm dừng", an "ends" date already past), is left out. An airline's service on a route is "charter" if every listing that counts marks it charter, else "seasonal" if every one marks it seasonal, else "scheduled".
rules.domestic: A domestic route is a pair of the 22 airports with an airline listed for it on the articles of both airports (in either language): the airline is listed under A with destination B and under B with destination A. Pairs listed at one end only are kept apart in `one_sided`, not drawn.
rules.international: An international route is a Vietnamese airport and a foreign airport (an IATA code in OurAirports outside Vietnam) listed in the Vietnamese airport's English or Vietnamese article; the foreign airport's own article is not read.
